speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education) (Schools)
text: If necessary, the Ministry will conduct its own investigations to establish the facts and to take appropriate disciplinary action.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education) (Schools)
text: The safety of students is topmost in the Ministry's mind when it manages such cases.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education) (Schools)
text: Educators who have transgressed and fallen short of the Ministry's standards of expected behaviour form a very small minority of the teaching force.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education) (Schools)
text: However, every case is one case too many.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education) (Schools)
text: We expect all educators to conduct themselves in a manner which upholds the integrity of the profession and the trust placed in them.

speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
text: And I am sure that for all these cases, we know of those that have been detected, but how many cases go unreported or undetected at all?

speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
text: Is there a whistle-blowing sort of mechanism within the education system?

speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
text: Do you teach the students what is sexual harassment?

speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
text: Is there a hotline for them to call?

speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
text: Is there a secret survey that is done among the student population to find out how prevalent the issue is?

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: I can certainly look to see if it is available.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: The issue of sexual misconduct and how it is dealt with in the school system, we can look at it from the point of view of the professionals, educators and we can look at it from the point of view of the students.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: The teachers or the educators have a high degree of trust placed on them and they are in a privileged position as adults in a position of responsibility and authority over their charges.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: The expectation of behaviour is codified in a code of conduct and this framework serves as a way that the Ministry, as well as the professional development agencies through NIE, trains the teachers.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: It is made clear at the point of recruitment and there are specific training sessions within the training at the time of induction into the service and then as part of professional development after service has begun.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: It is explicitly stated what are expected behaviours and what are behaviours that should be refrained from and avoided.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: These are conducted by specially-trained teachers who have an affinity and the rapport and are able to communicate the key issues.
